invariants.rationale: The method iterates over elements in layers; layers must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The length of any array in Java is non-negative.
If layers has any elements, the first must be a valid MapLayer index.
All used indices in layers must be valid for get() on map.getLayers().
The method assumes map and its layers list are non-null to use getLayers().get(idx).
